hero.heading: Ignite 2026
hero.description: Join us on 15–16 September for two days of innovation, technology, competitions, and creativity.
hero.aboutPreview: A premier technical celebration of innovation, engineering, and creativity — Ignite brings together the brightest minds to compete, build, and showcase.

events.name: TechThrive Grand Finale
events.description: TechTribe Grand Finale is the grand culmination of the Science Festival Hackathon, organized by Codex Club. With an overwhelming participation of 500+ students across 80 teams, the competition brings together the top 43 finalist teams for the ultimate showdown. At the Grand Finale, these 43 teams will compete head-to-head to showcase their innovative ideas, technical skills, and working solutions. It is a final test of creativity, problem-solving, collaboration, and innovation where the best teams will compete for the top honors.

events.name: Product Expo
events.description: Project Expo is a flagship event organized under Ignite 2026 on the occasion of PGSJ, where every department gets an opportunity to showcase its best projects, innovative models, working prototypes, and creative posters. Departments will compete for the top prizes, celebrating innovation, technical knowledge, creativity, and teamwork. Every participant will receive a certificate of participation. The expo provides students with a platform to present their ideas, gain practical exposure, improve communication and presentation skills, receive valuable feedback, and inspire others through their innovative work.

events.name: HP Exhibition
events.description: HP joins IGNITE 2026 to bring students closer to the latest technology and exciting offers. As part of the event, students can explore HP laptops and other products while availing exclusive discount coupons worth ₹1 lakh+ in total. The initiative provides students with an opportunity to discover technology suited to their academic and professional needs while enjoying special benefits available during the fest. Visit the HP experience zone at IGNITE 2026 and explore the world of smarter technology.

events.name: GFG DSA Contest
events.description: Organized with GeeksforGeeks, the GFG DSA Contest at IGNITE 2026 is an exciting opportunity for students to put their problem-solving and programming skills to the test. Participants will tackle carefully designed challenges based on Data Structures and Algorithms, competing against fellow innovators and coders. The event encourages logical thinking, efficient coding, and a competitive spirit while providing a platform for students to showcase their technical abilities. Join us to code, compete, and challenge yourself beyond the classroom.

events.name: SIH Webinar
events.description: SIH Webinar will be organized by Codex Club for students and teams qualified for the Smart India Hackathon (SIH). The session will be led by an SIH-qualified team that was also a winner at SIH 2025, giving participants the opportunity to learn directly from their experience. The team will share practical insights on problem-solving, project development, pitching, team strategy, and hackathon preparation. It will also be an interactive session, allowing participants to ask questions, discuss challenges, and gain valuable guidance for the next stage of SIH.

events.name: BGMI Tournament
events.description: The BGMI Tournament at IGNITE 2026 brings together gaming enthusiasts for an action-packed competitive experience. Participants will compete in intense battles that test their strategy, teamwork, communication, and quick decision-making skills. Whether you're a seasoned player or a passionate gamer, this tournament offers the perfect platform to showcase your skills and compete with the best. Get ready to team up, strategize, and battle your way to victory in an exciting esports experience at IGNITE 2026.

events.name: Technical Treasure Hunt
events.description: Technical Treasure Hunt is an exciting challenge designed exclusively for hostelers, combining technology, logic, teamwork, and quick thinking. Participants will solve a series of technical clues, puzzles, and challenges to uncover the final treasure. The event encourages problem-solving, creativity, and collaboration in a fun and competitive environment. Get ready to team up with your friends, test your skills, and experience an unforgettable adventure filled with excitement, learning, and friendly competition!
